results.note: OpenCloud routes .pdf to its built-in /pdf-viewer/ (pdf.js), NOT the WO editor. No OOXML edit loop needed for PDF. Correct behavior.

conclusion: word + sheet + slide fully ported and verified through the Rust WOPI bridge; pdf correctly uses the native viewer; diagram (.vsdx) is the sole genuine port gap (not wired end-to-end).
